changelog:
- Initial release of alphagbm-options-strategy skill.
- Recommends multi-leg option strategies based on market view (bullish, bearish, neutral, volatile).
- Supports over 15 strategy templates (spreads, condors, straddles, income plays).
- Returns full P&L profile, breakevens, Greeks, and probability of profit for each recommendation.
- Includes detailed strategy selection logic and example API usage.
- Demo mode available for select tickers without API key.
